theme_strategy: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY (Dark Mode Command Center)
design_philosophy: Venturelyx is an Operating System, not a generic SaaS. The Command Center must feel like a high-end Bloomberg Terminal crossed with Apple's precision. It uses a deeply engineered Dark Mode with vibrant, highly accessible data accents. The interface is stark, dense, and action-oriented. We do not use 'toy' colors or soft pastels here.

headings.usage: H1-H4. Must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) to feel engineered and precise. No generic sans.

body.usage: Data tables, paragraphs, and UI labels. Extremely legible at small sizes.

mono.usage: Numerical data, metric cards, Growth Score, and AI streaming text outputs.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: High Density Grid. Every pixel matters. Modified F-Pattern for Command Center.
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: w-64 or w-72 flex-shrink-0 border-r border-[#262626] h-screen sticky top-0

command_center_grid.growth_score: col-span-1 md:col-span-2 row-span-2 (North Star metric, highly visual)

surface_strategies.standard_cards: Flat solid background (#121212), 1px border (#262626), rounded-lg. No box-shadows. On hover: border-slate-700 -translate-y-[1px] transition-all duration-200.
surface_strategies.ai_streaming_panels: Glassmorphism with a technical edge. bg-[#0C101F]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-indigo-500/20. Inner glow shadow.
surface_strategies.fix_this_for_me_btn: The 'Tracing Beam' effect or a high-contrast Indigo pill button with an animating left-to-right subtle sheen.
surface_strategies.locked_modules: Opacity-50, grayscale filter, with a minimal 'Lock' icon and 'Coming V2' mono-spaced tag. Non-clickable or opens a 'Coming Soon' tooltip.

buttons.primary: bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium hover:bg-indigo-700 transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500/50
buttons.secondary: bg-[#171717] text-white border border-[#333] rounded-md px-4 py-2 hover:border-[#555] transition-colors
buttons.ai_action: bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-violet-600 text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-bold shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(99,102,241,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(99,102,241,0.5)] transition-all

components.metric_cards: Include a top label, a massive mono-spaced numerical value, and a small +/- percentage indicator in Emerald/Danger. Replace empty charts with 'Action needed' CTA.

pipeline_board.column: bg-[#0A0A0A] rounded-lg border border-[#262626] flex flex-col min-w-[300px] h-full
pipeline_board.card: bg-[#171717] border border-[#333] p-4 rounded-md cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing hover:border-slate-500 transition-colors

components.inputs: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-[#333] rounded-md focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500 text-white px-3 py-2

motion_and_interactions.page_transition: Fade in with a slight Y-axis upward drift (10px).
motion_and_interactions.ai_streaming: Staggered typewriter effect for text chunks, or opacity fade-in per paragraph. Ensure cursor blinks at the end of streaming text.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must change background or border explicitly. Do not rely on opacity changes.
motion_and_interactions.loading: No spinning circles. Use skeleton pulses matching the card background (#171717) or technical ascii-style loaders.

iconography_and_assets.library: phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight for a polished, readable dashboard feel).

data_visualizations.rules: Charts MUST not have default grid lines. Hide grid lines entirely or use stroke='#262626' strokeDasharray='3 3'. Chart tooltip MUST have a dark bg (#121212) with a 1px border. Do not use generic tooltips.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets at least 4.5:1 ratio. Muted text (#737373) is only for non-essential labels. Use #A3A3A3 for readable secondary text.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (sidebar links, fix-this-buttons, drag cards, AI approval panels) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='fix-seo-button'`).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Never use `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`.
DO NOT use a fully transparent background on headers or dropdowns. Ensure solid or blurred surfaces are used.
DO NOT center text in the app container universally (`.App { text-align: center; }`). Keep dashboards strictly left-aligned.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭) for icons. Use Phosphor icons.
Implement Sonner (`/app/src/components/ui/sonner.js` or `.tsx` if available) for toast notifications, configured to a dark theme.
Prioritize HTML semantics. Use proper headings (h1, h2, h3) and sections.
Build the dashboard explicitly utilizing the provided dark mode color palette. Do NOT default to light mode shadcn if not specified.
